This directory contains the SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation from the official
SQLite download, pinned to `sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip` with SHA3-256
`92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`.

Upstream identifies SQLite as public-domain software. The amalgamation is
compiled into the Runtime with extension loading disabled and bounded SQL,
column, and value sizes. Upstream download and build details are documented at
https://sqlite.org/amalgamation.html.
